titleEn: Half and Half, Twice the Steam!

pages.text: Only one steamed bun remained in the basket. Kota quickly picked it up. Just then, a young tanuki peeked into the kitchen.
The tanuki's eyes stayed on the bun. Grrrrowl! A hungry tummy rumbled through the kitchen. Kota slipped the bun behind their back.
"...But there's only one for me." Kota shuffled backward. The tanuki lowered their head sadly.
Dad put the bun on a plate and brought a knife. "Want to see some magic? One can become two." "Two?" Kota tilted their head.
Dad sliced it in half. Two soft streams of warm steam puffed up! "Wow! Twice the steam!"
Kota offered half to the tanuki. "Here—a steamy half!" The tanuki's face brightened.
They sat side by side and took a bite. "Delicious!" "Really delicious!" Twice the happy voices, too! Kota's tail shot up.
The tanuki broke a little off their half and popped it into Kota's mouth. "This is to say thank you!" With cheeks full, they smiled at each other.
Another day, only one bun remained. Kota held the edge of a paw over it and counted. "One, cut in half! Two, two trails of steam! Three, yum together!" Sharing doubled the smiles.
Dad poked Kota's full cheeks, then they patted their tummies together. "Sharing doesn't just make halves. It makes twice as much joy." "Half and half, twice the steam!" Kota giggled.
